faqs.question: How do I register for StudentHub?
faqs.answer: Create an account using your student ID and email address.

faqs.question: How can I view my dashboard?
faqs.answer: Log in and click the Dashboard menu from the navigation bar.

faqs.question: How do I update my profile?
faqs.answer: Go to the Profile page and click the Edit Profile button.

faqs.question: How can I check upcoming events?
faqs.answer: Open the Event page from the navigation bar to see upcoming campus events.

faqs.question: Who can I contact for support?
faqs.answer: Use the Contact page to send your questions or feedback to StudentHub.

faqs.question: How do I change my StudentHub password?
faqs.answer: Open your Profile page and use the password settings to change your password.

faqs.question: Where can I find my assignments?
faqs.answer: Open the Assignments page from the StudentHub dashboard to view your current assignments.

faqs.question: How can I check my achievements?
faqs.answer: Open the Achievements page to view certificates, awards and other academic achievements.

faqs.question: Can I search for a specific FAQ?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the search box at the top of the FAQ page to search questions and answers.

faqs.question: How do I contact the StudentHub support team?
faqs.answer: Go to the Contact page and submit the contact form with your name, email, subject and message.
